title: VCC project creation loops after remote repository timeout
error_signature: The request was canceled due to the configured HttpClient.Timeout of 600 seconds elapsing.
symptom: Creating either an avatar or world project stalls after a remote VPM repository request times out.
trigger: Create a project while a configured repository such as the VRCFury repo does not respond within 600 seconds.

title: Turkish locale breaks Udon Graph Interact event binding
symptom: Interact never fires and Interaction Text is absent while other events work.
trigger: Use Udon Graph Event Interact on a system with Turkish tr-TR locale.
root_cause: The report identifies culture-sensitive lowercasing producing dotless ı in the assembled event symbol.
workaround: Use UdonSharp for the same logic or a non-Turkish locale.

title: VCC opens to a persistent white screen
symptom: Creator Companion opens as a blank white screen instead of the project UI.
trigger: Launch Creator Companion in the reported environment.

title: Unity projects opened from VCC crash regardless of assets
symptom: New and existing Unity projects crash when opened through the Creator Companion workflow.
trigger: Open a bare or existing project in the reported VCC environment.

title: ClientSim cannot interact through a station collider although VRChat can
symptom: An interactable behind a station collider is ignored in ClientSim while the current VRChat client permits the interaction.
trigger: Place a station collider between the ray caster and an interactable object.
root_cause: The report points to an intentional historical collider-ignore check that no longer matches current client behavior.

title: ClientSim processes EditorOnly destruction at a different time than the real build
symptom: ClientSim can reference EditorOnly objects during build processing or fail to delete objects that the real build removes.
trigger: Use build-time hierarchy changes involving EditorOnly objects.
root_cause: The report attributes the mismatch to DestroyEditorOnly running at a different point from SDK scene processing.

title: ClientSim settings spam API errors while VRChat SDK is logged out
error_signature: Api Web Request send before online mode is initialized.
symptom: Opening ClientSim settings while logged out continuously spams the Unity Console.
trigger: Open the settings window with the VRChat SDK logged out.
workaround: Log in to the VRChat SDK before opening the settings path.

title: ALCOM package install panics on symlinks pointing outside the package directory
error_signature: thread 'tokio-rt-worker' panicked at 'unknown file type: none of file, dir, symlink'
symptom: Installing a user package containing external symlinks errors and leaves ALCOM spinning until fully stopped.
trigger: Register and install a user package whose README/LICENSE symlinks point outside the package directory.
root_cause: The stack trace reaches copy_recursive and panics on the file type encountered through the symlink case.

title: ALCOM 1.1.6–1.1.7 installer cannot bootstrap WebView2 in a clean environment
symptom: The installer fails to start the WebView2 installer when WebView2 is absent.
trigger: Install ALCOM 1.1.6–1.1.7 in a Windows environment without WebView2.

title: ALCOM hides an installed legacy package after installing its superseding package
symptom: Poiyomi Toon and Pro can coexist, collide with duplicate assemblies, and the superseded Toon package disappears from ALCOM's uninstall UI.
trigger: Install unlocked com.poiyomi.toon then install com.poiyomi.pro, which declares Toon as a legacy package.
root_cause: The report identifies legacy package removal skipping unlocked packages and the UI deleting legacy rows even when files remain.
workaround: Remove the legacy package manually and reinstall the superseding package if required to restore compilation.

title: ALCOM AppImage shows a permanent white GUI on Ubuntu 26.04
error_signature: Could not create default EGL display: EGL_BAD_PARAMETER
symptom: The AppImage creates a window but the content remains permanently white.
trigger: Launch ALCOM AppImage on the reported Ubuntu 26.04 environment.
root_cause: The report observes libgvfsdbus/libgvfscommon symbol failures and EGL display creation failure.

title: Modular Avatar Vertex Filter By Mask loses the material-slot dropdown
symptom: The custom inspector no longer exposes the material-slot dropdown.
trigger: Inspect MA Vertex Filter - By Mask in the reported package versions.
workaround: Switch the Inspector to Debug and edit the value manually.

title: Modular Avatar Shape Changer preview can stop updating until Unity restarts
symptom: Shape Changer preview, and reportedly Blendshape Sync/Object Toggle preview, can stop reflecting changes.
trigger: Preview reactive components until the preview enters the reported broken state.

title: Merge Armature does not follow Hips rotation across Blender/3ds Max FBX conventions
symptom: An outfit FBX exported from 3ds Max fails to follow avatar Hips rotation when merged into a Blender-origin avatar.
trigger: Merge armatures with the reported 90-degree Hips rest-rotation mismatch between exporters.
root_cause: The report identifies differing Blender and 3ds Max FBX bone rotation conventions as the apparent cause.

title: Trailing question mark in NDMF package URL causes HTTP 502 in VPM clients
symptom: ALCOM/VPM clients cannot download an NDMF package URL ending with a bare question mark.
trigger: Resolve the malformed release URL from the VPM listing.
root_cause: The report identifies a trailing ? appended to the package download URL.
solution: Remove the trailing question mark from the package URL.
workaround: Use the corrected URL without the trailing question mark.

title: NDMF Console throws NullReferenceException after package updates and Play Mode
error_signature: System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
symptom: NDMF reports an internal plugin NullReferenceException after project package updates and entering Play Mode.
trigger: Update project packages and enter Play Mode in the reported project state.

title: Trace and Optimize can delete a MeshRenderer controlled by MA Object Toggle
symptom: A MeshRenderer object managed by MA Object Toggle can be removed during optimization under a particular hierarchy.
trigger: Run Trace And Optimize on the affected MA Object Toggle hierarchy.

title: Avatar Optimizer 1.9.11 removes overlapping VRCPhysBone components
symptom: VRCPhysBone components intentionally targeting overlapping hierarchies are removed in 1.9.11 but preserved in 1.9.10.
trigger: Build the provided overlapping PhysBone hierarchy with Avatar Optimizer 1.9.11.
workaround: Use 1.9.10 until the regression is fixed.

title: Trace and Optimize changes behavior of U Shop weapon gimmicks
symptom: Weapon magazine follow and world-fixed gimmick behavior become incorrect when Trace and Optimize is present.
trigger: Use the reported U Shop weapon gimmicks together with Trace And Optimize.
workaround: Remove Avatar Optimizer; the reporter states both symptoms disappear.

title: lilOptimizer can take minutes when the same BlendTree is reachable by many paths
symptom: Complex BlendTree graphs can cause the optimizer to process the same clips tens of thousands of times and take minutes.
trigger: Use a graph where the same BlendTree/AnimationClip is reachable through many paths.
root_cause: The report identifies missing deduplication in VRChatModule.GetAnimationClipsFromGameObject.

title: lilToon material optimization bakes UV tiling incorrectly
symptom: Baking an optimized material with non-1 UV tiling produces a texture with the tiling baked incorrectly.
trigger: Use UV Tiling such as X=1/Y=2 and bake layers/material optimization.

title: Poiyomi LTCGI breaks the shader at Android/Quest runtime
symptom: Enabling LTCGI causes the material to render broken or invisible at Android/Quest runtime despite appearing in the Editor.
trigger: Enable LTCGI and run the shader on Android/Quest.
workaround: Disable LTCGI for the affected Android/Quest path.

title: Gesture Manager reports VRCRaycast Hit false while the component reports true
symptom: The raycast component Hit bool is true but Gesture Manager debug parameters report false; the same setup works in VRChat.
trigger: Use the newer VRCRaycast component with Gesture Manager emulation.
workaround: Validate the behavior in VRChat rather than relying on Gesture Manager for this parameter.
